checkpoints.description: Task 'away-teams-v1' completed successfully.

[1/6] Plan: galaxy/faction/pirate expansion; 25+ blocking decision events; mission board + counters; quantum trade orders with transit fees; landing surface operations; realistic population/war devastation + outliner height. Each milestone keeps tests green.

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for substantially more simulation depth across encounters, decisions, missions, economics, landing, factions and war consequences. Existing anomalies are jump-only, trade is instant local only, landing is a single reward button, and war captures never hurt populations.
impact_assessment.benefits: More systems/factions and pirate zones widen the map; blocking decisions create real-time tension; a mission board and counters reward play; quantum trade adds logistics; surface operations make landing a choice; devastation makes war consequential and population believable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive defaulted model fields and snapshot keys, new REST/CLI surfaces; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: engine lock and tick guards, UI modal must not deadlock; state: deterministic seeds, old-save defaults, blocked ticks must pause cleanly
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure data modules for events/events catalog and quantum routes, failing-first tests per mechanic, engine guard helper for pending decisions, backward-compatible from_dict tests, real-Edge 3-viewport review, full gates before completion
